name: @cytoscape-web/project-template
description: Boilerplate app with a panel, a menu action, a context menu item, and the recommended Cytoscape Web plugin shape.
//cyweb: This app's identity, written ONCE. The federation container name, the
CyApp.id and the dev install manifest all read from here — before this
block they were three hand-synced string literals with no import between
them, and nothing noticed a mismatch until the host refused to load.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json

//dependencies: Everything this app needs is declared HERE, not inherited from the
monorepo root. Copying this directory out is the documented way to start
an app, and the previous package.json had scripts and nothing else — so a
copy did not install. React, MUI, TypeScript and the API types all
resolved by hoisting, which works in exactly one place.
//peerDependencies: react, react-dom, @mui/material and both Emotion packages are provided by
the HOST as Module Federation singletons — the share block uses
`import: false`, so no fallback copy is bundled. They are peers rather
than dependencies to say that. The version ranges must match
cross-checks them, because nothing else would notice them diverging.
//devDependencies: @cytoscape-web/app-runtime owns the build configuration and carries the
Module Federation runtime plugin. It is why adm-zip, @types/adm-zip and
@module-federation/runtime are gone from here: the zip plugin and the
runtime-plugin test both moved into the package.
vite, @module-federation/vite and @vitejs/plugin-react stay, as the SDK's
peers — one copy of each, resolved from the app.
